data.summary: “RACING OVER MASSIVE FENCES! 😱” has pulled 20,047,246 views at ~47,020/hour — well above a normal upload. It reads as a product/review whose strongest lever is velocity. The breakdown below frames the rest as likely contributors, not proven causes.

why_trending.detail: Views are accumulating far faster than a typical upload, and that early velocity likely compounds into broader recommendation.
The setup withholds the resolution, likely driving rewatches and completion — both strong short-form ranking signals.
The framing targets a broad, relatable everyday situation, which likely widens the share-and-comment audience.

outlier_insight.headline: **4.6× their own median** — **script** is what broke the pattern.
outlier_insight.pattern_break: Their other clips top out near **7.1M** (e.g. “HERO FAKES HIS JUMPS! 😱”); this one **4.6×'d** their median. The break: it leans harder on **script** than their usual product/review uploads.
outlier_insight.why_it_spread: Spread via **early-engagement velocity** the algorithm caught and amplified.
outlier_insight.steal_this: **One idea, tightly scripted** — no throat-clearing; every line sets up the next.
outlier_insight.replicability_note: the spike came from timing as much as content.
